name: panel-review
description: Multi-model second-opinion deliberation for high-stakes coding decisions, with proactive review gates. Skills route to the TruVerifAI MCP server, where four frontier models reason independently and conflict-target each other's positions. A local PreToolUse classifier gates risky writes and git commits until a review covers them — only a repo fingerprint and content hashes ever leave your machine, never source.
